state:
Goal `core-os-and-2-more` is met: `dossier-core-os`, `dossier-core-out` and `dossier-core-password` all pass `bun nv proofs --verify`.
`Core\Password` has its class card, plain-voice cards for `hash`, `verify` and `needsRehash`, an `about.md`, three examples, one attack, one bench and a recorded figure per member, and a Rust `covers:` test each in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/password.rs`.
The attack on `verify` found that a stored hash's pass count was unbounded (a `t=1000000` row was over an hour of one core). `verify` now refuses a PHC hash whose memory times passes is past `MAX_WORK` (4 GiB of passes, libsodium's `SENSITIVE` preset). The module doc's *`verify` bounds what the stored hash may ask for* section owns it, and `tests/conformance/core/password-verify-refuses-a-stored-pass-count-past-its-work-ceiling.nvst` pins it.
`needsRehash` allocates three times per Argon2id string it parses (the argon2 crate's PHC parser), and its bench declares the measured mix as `allocations 2`.
